integrity: Self-contained theoretical proof and standalone modular-rank checker; finite experiments support but do not prove general claims.
scientific_limitations: Degree at most two and entire interior Hamming shells only; no conditioning estimate. The proof gives all ranks. Direct prior full-text inspection was limited by inaccessible preprints and published research records; independence and publication priority are not externally certified.
title: Three-snapshot recovery and square-dimensional obstructions on Boolean Hamming shells
